story: Jack Shanahan debut Royal Drift Series China
title: JACK SHANAHAN DEBUTS IN CHINA

headline: JACK SHANAHAN
DEBUTS IN
CHINA
data.body: Jack Shanahan made his Royal Drift Series debut at the Shaoxing season finale (Nov 4-8), driving a Toyota GR86 for the Shanghai PerfecMod APEX Drift Team. Conor Falvey was in the same team. The round was won by Daigo Saito, and 2026 Drift Masters champion Paweł Korpuliński was on the entry list too.
